bash -lc cat > /tmp/boot_vm.sh <<'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Boot Debian 12 cloud image with NoCloud seed + SSH on 2222
SEED_ISO="/tmp/seed.iso"
DISK="/app/debian.qcow2"
PIDFILE="/tmp/qemu.pid"
HOST_PORT=2222
GUEST_PORT=22
MAX_WAIT=120

fail() { echo "ERROR: $1"; exit 1; }

[ -f "$DISK" ] || fail "disk image not found at $DISK"
[ -f "$SEED_ISO" ] || fail "seed ISO not found at $SEED_ISO"
# verify seed ISO contains user-data and meta-data
if ! isoinfo -l -i "$SEED_ISO" 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "USER_DAT"; then
  fail "seed ISO missing user-data"
fi
if ! isoinfo -l -i "$SEED_ISO" 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "META_DAT"; then
  fail "seed ISO missing meta-data"
fi

# cleanup any stale instance (avoid pkill self-match with [q]emu pattern)
if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  OLDPID=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -n "$OLDPID" ] && kill -0 "$OLDPID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$OLDPID" 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 2
    kill -9 "$OLDPID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  rm -f "$PIDFILE"
fi
for p in $(pgrep -f "qemu-system-x86_64.*2222" 2>/dev/null); do
  kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
sleep 1
# free the port if something else holds it
fuser -k 2222/tcp 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /tmp/qemu-serial.log

# KVM detection with graceful fallback to TCG
ACCEL_ARGS=""
if [ -e /dev/kvm ]; then
  ACCEL_ARGS="-accel kvm"
  echo "Using KVM acceleration" >&2
else
  ACCEL_ARGS="-accel tcg"
  echo "KVM not available, falling back to TCG" >&2
fi

# Start QEMU daemonized
qemu-system-x86_64 \
  $ACCEL_ARGS \
  -m 1024 \
  -smp 2 \
  -drive file="$DISK",if=virtio,format=qcow2 \
  -cdrom "$SEED_ISO" \
  -netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 \
  -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0 \
  -display none \
  -serial file:/tmp/qemu-serial.log \
  -daemonize \
  -pidfile "$PIDFILE" \
  || fail "QEMU failed to start (exit $?)"

sleep 1
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  fail "QEMU PID file not created"
fi
QPID=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
if ! kill -0 "$QPID" 2>/dev/null; then
  fail "QEMU process not running"
fi
# verify correct port forwarding in cmdline
if ! tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$QPID/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q "hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22"; then
  fail "QEMU port forwarding misconfigured"
fi
echo "QEMU_STARTED"

# --- robust SSH readiness check: exponential backoff from 1s, 120s total ---
START=$(date +%s)
WAIT=1
BANNER_OK=0
while true; do
  NOW=$(date +%s)
  ELAPSED=$((NOW - START))
  if [ "$ELAPSED" -ge "$MAX_WAIT" ]; then
    fail "SSH not ready after ${MAX_WAIT}s (timeout)"
  fi
  # grab SSH banner with short timeout; capture state
  BANNER=""
  ERR=""
  BANNER=$(timeout 4 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/2222; cat <&3' 2>&1 | head -c 255)
  RC=$?
  # timeout returns 124 on timeout; bash /dev/tcp errors contain refused/timed out
  if echo "$BANNER" | grep -q "^SSH-2.0"; then
    echo "STATE: SSH banner detected: $(echo \"$BANNER\" | head -1)" >&2
    BANNER_OK=1
    # verify actual password prompt via expect
    EXPECT_OUT=$(expect <<'EXPECT_EOF' 2>&1
set timeout 10
spawn ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -p 2222 root@127.0.0.1
set matched 0
expect {
  -re "(?i)password.*:" { puts "EXPECT_PASSWORD_PROMPT"; exit 0 }
  -re "Password.*:" { puts "EXPECT_PASSWORD_PROMPT"; exit 0 }
  timeout { puts "EXPECT_TIMEOUT"; exit 1 }
  eof { puts "EXPECT_EOF"; exit 1 }
}
EXPECT_EOF
)
    ERC=$?
    echo "$EXPECT_OUT" >&2
    if echo "$EXPECT_OUT" | grep -q "EXPECT_PASSWORD_PROMPT"; then
      echo "SSH_READY"
      exit 0
    fi
    # banner ok but no password prompt yet (sshd still starting) -> keep polling
    echo "STATE: SSH banner ok, waiting for password prompt..." >&2
  else
    if echo "$BANNER" | grep -qi "refused"; then
      echo "STATE: connection refused (elapsed ${ELAPSED}s)" >&2
    elif [ "$RC" -eq 124 ]; then
      echo "STATE: timeout connecting (elapsed ${ELAPSED}s)" >&2
    elif [ -z "$BANNER" ]; then
      echo "STATE: connection refused/timeout, no data (elapsed ${ELAPSED}s, rc=$RC)" >&2
    else
      echo "STATE: not SSH yet: [$BANNER] (elapsed ${ELAPSED}s)" >&2
    fi
  fi
  sleep "$WAIT"
  WAIT=$((WAIT * 2))
  if [ "$WAIT" -gt 15 ]; then WAIT=15; fi
  NOW2=$(date +%s)
  if [ "$((NOW2 - START))" -ge "$MAX_WAIT" ]; then
    fail "SSH not ready after ${MAX_WAIT}s (timeout)"
  fi
done
SCRIPT_EOF

echo "script created"; cat /tmp/boot_vm.sh | head -30
